verdict.rationale: The pack never documents Kimi controlling a web browser to navigate sites or complete tasks on them. It shows only adjacent features: web search in Kimi Code, help-index titles for an agent mode, deep research, and a browser extension. None of these describes the assistant clicking, filling forms or acting on websites for the user. Web search and research reports are a different capability from browser operation.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can have the assistant operate a web browser on my behalf to research and complete tasks on websites
